text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Calls for a longer voter registration period for this year's general election pick up.
- Wildlife experts want Kenya to lead wildlife rich nations in opposing the resumption of ivory trade.
- Six people die after the vehicle they were travelling in overturns along the Nyeri-Nyahururu road in central province.
- Langata opposition member of parliament Raila Odinga says he has not abandoned his ambition to seek the presidency in this year's general election.
- Business tycoon Kamlesh Pattni clinches an out-of-court deal with the Central Bank of Kenya to purchase the prestigious Grand Regency Hotel in Nairobi.
- Rift Valley Provincial Commissioner Mohamed Yusuf instructs all district commissioners to issue rally permits to all political parties.
- Parliamentarian Orwa Ojode demands a public apology from embattled opposition FORD-Asili chairman Kenneth Matiba for ridiculing Raila Odinga.
- Nyeri town deputy mayor Njagi Kigo shoots dead a suspected thug. ($1=54 Kenya Shillings)
